method.method_draft: First read the calendar headers in the image as German weekday abbreviations: Mo, Di, Mi, Do, Fr, Sa, So. From the uncovered top row, note that the date 2 is in the Do/Thursday column and 3 is in the Fr/Friday column. Since dates advance one weekday per day, infer that the 1st was Wednesday. Then count forward from 1 to 27, or compute that 27 is 26 days after the 1st and 26 ≡ 5 mod 7. Five weekdays after Wednesday is Monday, so the 27th falls on Monday.
